title: Listening Forward: Next Patch Embedding Prediction Enables Scalable Audio Learners
abstract: arXiv:2608.19863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has driven substantial progress in audio representation learning, though existing methods have increasingly relied on elaborate pre-training recipes to reach competitive performance. A markedly different pre-training philosophy underpins the most influential progress in language modeling and, more recently, in visual representation learning: rather than train encoders as static feature extractors, models are trained to predict the next element, a discrete token or a continuous embedding, from the preceding context. Autoregressive prediction thereby provides a unified pre-training interface that transfers across modalities, compelling the model to learn the underlying data distribution. We ask whether such a simple causal paradigm can yield strong audio learners, given that audio's temporal structure makes autoregressive prediction of patch embeddings a natural fit. translated_title: 前瞻性聆听：下一补丁嵌入预测助力可扩展音频学习者
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19863v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：自监督学习（SSL）在音频表示学习方面取得了显著进展，尽管现有方法越来越依赖精心设计的预训练方案以达到竞争性性能。语言建模以及最近的视觉表示学习领域中最具影响力的进展，基于一种显著不同的预训练理念：与其将编码器训练为静态特征提取器，不如训练模型从先前上下文预测下一个元素，无论是离散标记还是连续嵌入。自回归预测因此提供了一种跨模态转移的统一预训练接口，迫使模型学习底层数据分布。鉴于音频的时间结构使补丁嵌入的自回归预测成为自然契合，我们探讨这种简单的因果范式能否产生强大的音频学习者。我们引入了NAPE（下一音频补丁嵌入）。
tldr: 本文提出NAPE方法，通过自回归预测下一音频补丁嵌入，验证了简单的因果预训练范式在音频学习中的有效性，无需复杂预训练方案即可实现竞争性性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NAPE, which leverages autoregressive prediction of the next audio patch embedding to validate that a simple causal pre-training paradigm can achieve competitive performance in audio learning without elaborate pre-training recipes.
